'''Eben''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Empire. In [[3643 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], where he requested supply vehicles from [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Bessiker]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Colonel Eben appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the Sith Inquisitor class mission on Balmorra.
